settings.models.title: Models
settings.models.intro: Enter your API keys to use models from the following providers.
settings.models.deleteDescription: Deleting {provider} removes its configuration. Any credential it uses is managed elsewhere and will be kept.
settings.models.deleteDescriptionWithCredential: Deleting {provider} removes its configuration and stored API key.
settings.models.addCatalogHint: Pick OpenAI, Anthropic, Kimi, or another provider from the built-in catalog and enter its API key.
settings.models.addCustomHint: Connect a relay, a self-hosted server, or any other OpenAI- or Anthropic-compatible endpoint by its base URL, protocol, and models.
settings.models.addCatalogExhausted: Every catalog provider is already configured.
settings.models.addCustomUnavailable: No API protocol is available to declare.
settings.models.readOnly: The settings document is read-only in this deployment.
settings.models.conflict: Someone else changed these settings while this card was open. Close it and reopen to edit the current values.
settings.models.keyPlaceholderFallback: Leave blank to use env as auth ({hint})
settings.models.keyPlaceholderSaved: Leave blank to use saved credentials
settings.models.keyFallbackMissing: Env var not detected. Enter an API key, or configure {hint} in your env.
settings.models.keyFallbackUnchecked: Environment credential status has not been confirmed.
settings.models.keyHelp: Saved credentials are used first. Environment fallbacks shown here, in order: {env}. Sources are launch environment, $cwd/.env, then $DSH_HOME/.env.
settings.models.deepSeekEndpointHint: Use an API endpoint compatible with Anthropic Messages.
settings.models.modelNamePlaceholder: Uses the model ID when empty
settings.models.modelReasoningHelpText: The API value is sent in the request's reasoning-effort field, such as OpenAI's reasoning_effort. It defaults to the level name; where the model provider's API documentation specifies a different value, follow it. Off turns reasoning off and needs no value; a value already written in the configuration is kept and sent.
settings.models.modelReasoningNeedsLevel: Add at least one level besides Off, or turn reasoning levels off.
settings.models.modelReasoningValueRequired: Every level besides Off needs an API value, and no value can be empty.
settings.models.modelsEmpty: No models will be shown in the selector. Unlisted IDs can still be sent directly.
settings.models.keyBlank: Enter the API key, or leave the field empty to keep the stored one.
settings.models.keyBlankNew: Enter the API key, or leave the field empty if this provider authenticates another way.
settings.models.keyIllegalCharacters: This API key is not in a valid format. Please check it.
settings.models.modelContextInvalid: Context window must be a positive count, like 131072, 256K, or 1M.
settings.models.modelMaxTokensInvalid: Max output tokens must be a positive count, like 8192, 64K, or 1M.
settings.models.advancedHint: Other fields live in cordis.patch.yml; edit that section directly.
settings.models.modelCapacityInvalid: A capacity must be a number, optionally suffixed K or M.
settings.models.modelDuplicate: Each model ID may appear once.
settings.models.fetchNeedsBaseUrl: Enter the base URL first, then fetch.
settings.models.fetchEmpty: The provider listed no models. Add them by hand.
settings.models.fetchDescription: These are the models this provider has available. Choose the ones to add.
settings.models.customRouteHint: Lowercase identifier, starting with a letter, that uniquely names this provider in requests and as its credential name.
settings.models.customRouteInvalid: Start with a lowercase letter; then lowercase letters, digits, and dashes.
settings.models.customRouteTaken: A provider already uses this ID.
settings.models.customNeedsBaseUrl: A custom provider needs a base URL.
settings.models.customBaseUrlInvalid: Enter a valid HTTP or HTTPS URL.
settings.models.customNeedsModels: A custom provider needs at least one model.
settings.models.welcomeBody:
DeepSeek Harness 0.2 is still in preview, and many areas need continued improvement and refinement. We welcome feedback and suggestions from all developers and users. The new desktop app now targets a broad range of users, while developer-related advanced features can be enabled in the settings. DeepSeek Harness’s product features and plugin APIs are expected to continue rapid iteration and evolution, and will gradually stabilize over time.

We look forward to exploring the limits of intelligence together with users and developers around the world, building on open-source, reusable, and composable infrastructure. We welcome everyone to bring their ideas to life with DeepSeek Harness and participate in the community to enrich the plugin ecosystem.

settings.webSearch.title: Web search
settings.webSearch.description: Set up the DeepSeek search provider.
settings.webSearch.useSearchApi: Use the new Web Search API
settings.webSearch.useSearchApiHint: Off by default: search runs through DeepSeek Messages. For the new Web Search API's features and pricing, see the
settings.webSearch.apiKeyHint: Stored outside the settings file. Leave blank to keep the current key.
settings.webSearch.apiKeyUnset: No key is configured; only conversations using a DeepSeek Account model can search, through the default endpoint.
settings.webSearch.baseUrlHint: Include the API prefix, such as https://api.deepseek.com/anthropic/v1. The provider appends /messages. Leave blank to restore the default.
settings.webSearch.searchApiBaseUrlHint: Include the API prefix, such as https://api.deepseek.com/v1/tools. The provider appends /search or /fetch. Leave blank to restore the default.
settings.webSearch.maxUsesHint: How many searches the auxiliary model may run within one Messages request. Applies only to the Messages API.
settings.webSearch.countHint: Results returned per query: an integer from 1 to 50, default 10. This controls result count, not search calls. web_search keeps no more sources than its own result limit.
settings.webSearch.unavailable: This plugin is not loaded, so it cannot be configured right now.
settings.webSearch.saveFailed: The deployment did not accept these values; they were left for you to correct.
settings.webSearch.invalidNumber: Enter a number, or leave blank to use the default.
settings.webSearch.invalidCount: Enter an integer from 1 to 50, or leave blank to use the default.

settings.subagent.subagentDescription: Set Subagent recursion depth, count, and models.
